messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Data Tab "View" button error with RGtk2Extras package
parts:
Hi Greg,

RGtk2Extras seems to have been removed from CRAN.

You may be able to download and install one of the archive copies (http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/RGtk2Extras/index.html or https://r-forge.r-project.org/R/?group_id=924).

Until I work out a solution, you can always go to the R Console (after loading and transforming the data in Rattle) and type:

> View(crs$dataset)

Regards,
Graham



On 19 October 2012 06:38, Greg <gregar...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi everyone! I am new to this group, and new to data mining but find the rattle utility fantastic! I am however encountering an error I had hoped someone could help me with:

I am getting a R error when i click the view button on the Data tab (After bringing in any data file).

R console Error message:

--- Please select a CRAN mirror for use in this session ---
Loading required package: RGtk2Extras
Error in viewData() : could not find function "dfedit"
In addition: Warning messages:
1: package ‘RGtk2Extras’ is not available (for R version 2.15.1) 
2: In library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE,  :
  there is no package called ‘RGtk2Extras’

Running: Windows 7 64bit
Running: R version 2.1.5.1
Running: Rattle Version 2.6.21 (I also tried 2.6.22 same results)

I had tried to manually install RGtk2Extras from the archives with no success, the error seems to persist. I also tried several ways to search google to help me solve this issue with poor results. 

I was trying to look at the data after I made some data transformations and thought I could look at it via this view button. If there is some other easier way I'd love any help.

Thanks,

-Greg

--

messages.subject: Re: Data Tab "View" button error with RGtk2Extras package
parts:
Just one more thing. When you install R on windows, typically two versions of R (32-bit and 64-bit) are installed. I see that you ran into the problem using the 64-bit version of R. Was 'RGtk2Extras' also installed in this version of R? 

I don't know if this helps, but I find that I have to install RGtk (and RGtk2Extras) for 64-bit and 32-bit of R separately. This is especially useful when you want to try out Graham's book on ODBC (using the 32-bit ODBC drivers).

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Data Tab "View" button error with RGtk2Extras package
parts:
Hi Ray,

Thanks for the bug report. 

Rattle needed updating for the new version of dfedit in RGtk2Extras.

The updated source version is available from

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com")

(but not for the Mac I suppose - I don't have a Mac handy - sorry)

A workaround might be:

> dfedit <- function(..., pretty.print) RGtk2Extras:::dfedit(...)
> rattle()

Regards,
Graham
